---

## 1. Studio Overview

Snowfield is an applied AI implementation studio in Indianapolis founded by Jordan Masopust, serving established US businesses and remote product or operations teams.

Most internal AI rollouts fail before the model ever gets a fair test because real operating rules sit buried across stale wikis, ticket threads, and tribal knowledge. Buying a generic AI wrapper and locking prompts behind an agency retainer leads frontline staff to stop using it within weeks. Snowfield builds the other way around:

1. **Audit the operational signal first:** Identify contradicting playbooks, undocumented escalation rules, and messy catalog or ticket data before writing prompts.
2. **Build multi-model workflows with verification:** Route across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI based on where each model holds up, pairing Python, React, and SQL tooling with lean context budgets and blind-review QA checks so tools flag gaps when they do not know instead of fabricating an answer.
3. **Deploy inside accounts the client owns:** Every prompt, GitHub repository, and guide deploys directly inside accounts the client already owns and controls, paired with live team onboarding so internal staff can maintain and update rules without vendor lock-in.

---

## 2. Core Offerings & Capabilities

- **Custom Operational Assistants:** Multi-model assistants across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI with strict source-grounding rules and explicit refusal or escalation paths.
- **Structured Knowledge Systems:** Knowledge-base audits, Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) publishing workflows, and clean operational reference layers.
- **Role-Based Onboarding Web Apps:** Interactive onboarding, training, and live-call web applications in React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Python designed for non-technical staff under live floor pressure.
- **Multi-Model Orchestration & Blind QA:** Routing and independent cross-model verification pipelines with local state, audit trails, and strict grounding gates.
- **E-Commerce Catalog & Margin Diagnostics:** End-to-end catalog, search-compliance, pricing, and shipping-margin audit workflows for established physical-goods storefronts, turning raw shop data into ready-to-run fixes.

---

## 3. Founder: Jordan Masopust

Jordan Masopust is the Founder of Snowfield in Indianapolis. He has worked hands-on with language models since GPT-3 in July 2020. Across every operational floor he has worked on since, the engineering problem has stayed consistent: clean up the operational signal first, then ship tools non-technical staff actually reach for when a live call or escalation goes sideways.

### Representative Operational Builds
- **Loan-Officer Workflow Assistant (15 Versions):** Built a 15-version loan-officer assistant across Claude and Gemini that refuses rather than guessing on underwriting rules or state guidelines, paired with a setup guide and rollout proposal corporate IT adapted company-wide.
- **High-Volume B2B Sales Copilot & Live-Transfer Process:** Shipped a multi-model discovery and objection copilot on a high-volume B2B sales floor alongside a repeatable live-transfer process the team adopted.
- **Enterprise Restaurant POS Support Floor & Dispatch Workflow:** Led a 24/7 enterprise restaurant POS support floor of fifty agents across more than a thousand concepts, audited over half the knowledge base, and built a Dynamics 365 and Jira dispatch workflow that cut first-reply times by 40% and callbacks by 30%.
- **E-Commerce Storefront Catalog & Margin Diagnostics:** Built an end-to-end catalog, search-compliance, pricing, and shipping-margin audit workflow for an established physical-goods storefront.
- **Role-Based Operator Tools & Multi-Model Blind QA:** Built interactive onboarding, training, and live-call web apps in React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and Python, alongside cross-model verification pipelines across Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI.

### Full-Time Role Alignment
Alongside Snowfield, Jordan is open to full-time roles in:
- AI Implementation
- Solutions Engineering
- Workflow Deployment
- Technical Onboarding
